invariant: All discovered personnel class schemes receive labels on exactly the same preselected replacement events. Labels, outcomes and target geometry do not select events.

legacy_panel.replay_policy: Reuse recovered exact requests and available frozen state caches; rerun missing states only through original native fusion function. State reuse and new executions will be counted separately.
legacy_panel.reference_policy: inherited pool-bound frozen reference, never optimized by output score

nested_even_supplement.pools: all ordinary Manual pools having at least k+1 eligible distinct workers
nested_even_supplement.pair_selection: sorted unique eligible worker pairs, sample without replacement with deterministic pool-specific seed
nested_even_supplement.background_selection: for each selected unordered worker pair and replicate, deterministically permute all other eligible workers; use first k-1 workers as exact common background
nested_even_supplement.orientation: worker_a and worker_b lexicographic order; quality signed difference is B minus A, no chosen better side
nested_even_supplement.label: four even-number nodes only; not a full consecutive growth curve, not the missing Dot panel

outcomes: both endpoint completeness and failure reason
B8L2 and D10 signed and absolute quality differences
node count change and cyclic structure mismatch
observed-source connection change and retained original observations
source time sum and coverage, same-target time sum and coverage separately
tolerance_policy: Freeze inherited Pro strict/main/loose thresholds after reading exact native contract. Report distributions, bad tails, failures and individual components as well as joint stability. Non-significance is not evidence of equivalence.
uncertainty: resample buildings as clusters; no interpretation of team requests as independent human samples
cross_k_comparison: common selected worker pair and nested background chain IDs only; keep incomplete k coverage explicit
fairness: Report both each scheme's supported panel and the common supported event set. Also report classes without enough common replacement opportunity and singleton/dyad class coverage.
limitations: v2 retrospective leave-building-out evaluation, not new external blind validation
target actual clusters, point counts, and votes are oracle/conditional mechanism labels only
no adjacent odd/even experiment is run here; that belongs to external Codex Part B
no original annotations, references, qualification, scoring, fusion, or GitHub main changes
